title: Q-rule: every LLM files unanswerable questions as cards (not only in reports). Review and implement what is meaningful. Today: Operator: commit line, Control Room decisions, mts_signal [ask], CLAUDE.md line 9 defaults-for-open-questions, final chat report; no mandatory rule, defaults leave no trail, no owner/state/follow-up. Proposal: (1) one rule in CLAUDE.md: a question you cannot answer now and that blocks or changes a decision is filed before session end via tasks.py new (title prefix Q:) with evidence; report-only or chat-only does not count; (2) when proceeding on a default, also file the card naming the assumed default; (3) cards are the durable record, Control Room decision only for operator-only choices; (4) check whether stop_guard.py can flag Operator: or [ask] text with no matching card; (5) tasks.py list view of open Q: cards for planner/supervisor. Guard against card spam (only blocking or decision-changing questions). Ensure rule reaches Gemini/Codex via AGENTS.md/GEMINI.md pointers without copying rules. Review the proposal first, drop what has no value, ship the rest
